title: Model keys
subtitle: Your agents need an API key to talk to an AI model (OpenAI, Anthropic and others). Add a key here. It is stored encrypted and never shown again after you save it.
label: Label
valueKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored key
valueKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current key
baseUrlOptional: Optional: override the provider's default endpoint
modelsHint: Comma separated. Leave empty to allow any model from this provider.
budgetHint: 0 means no limit. At the limit, runs on this key stop and the key shows 'over budget' until the 1st of next month (UTC).
priceShown: Your price per 1M tokens: {{input}} input, {{output}} output, {{cache}} cached input
priceHint: What you pay on this key. Used to cost runs of a model our price list does not have, such as a custom endpoint; without it their cost shows as not known. Leave cached input empty to price it like input.
priceNoModels: With no models listed, this price applies to every model of this provider.
confirmDelete: Delete key {{label}}? Runs that use it will fail.
empty: No model keys yet. Add one so your agents can use a real AI model. Without a key you can still check that an agent runs, for free, with Check agent on its page; an evaluation needs a key.
unavailable: This server cannot save model keys yet. Admin: set HEIMDALL_MASTER_KEY and restart (see the hosting guide).

status.invalid: Problem: the provider refused this key
status.error: Problem: could not reach the provider

noDefault: No default model yet. Add a key and press Test.
baseUrlRequired: This provider needs a base URL.

picker.noKey: No key for this provider yet
picker.noResults: No model matches. Pick a provider and choose "Other model..." to type any id.
picker.needsKey: add a working key to use
picker.keyInvalidLong: This provider's key is not working

emptyViewer: No model keys yet. Ask an org admin to add one. Meanwhile you can browse finished comparisons.
secretsHint: Keys your agent's tools need, such as a web search key, are Secrets, not model keys.

defaultPrice.key: Price per 1M tokens: {{input}} in, {{output}} out, {{cache}} cached (from your key {{label}})
defaultPrice.priceList: Price per 1M tokens: {{input}} in, {{output}} out, {{cache}} cached (from the price list)
defaultPrice.none: Price per 1M tokens: not set (costs will show as unknown)

priceHintTitle: Heimdall works out cost from the model's price per 1 million tokens. When no price is set for a model, its cost shows as unknown, not as zero.

groupHints.open-hosts: Services that run open-weight models such as DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama and gpt-oss.
groupHints.self-hosted: A model server you run yourself. Give its base URL.
groupHints.custom: Any server that speaks the OpenAI API. Give its base URL ending in /v1.

selfHostedKeyHint: If your server has no key, type any text here.

open.title: Open models
open.subtitle: Open-weight model families and the providers that serve them. Add a key for one of those providers to use the family.
open.none: No provider in this server's list serves it yet.
open.custom: Or add a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint from {{maker}}.

serve.title: Serve an open model on your Modal account
serve.subtitle: Pick an open model, an engine and a GPU. Heimdall runs it on your own Modal account with scale to zero, adds it as your vLLM or SGLang key once it answers, and stops it when its evaluation ends or its time limit passes. Modal bills your account for the GPU time.
serve.cost: At most ${{max}} of GPU time over the time limit; nothing is billed while idle.
serve.gated: needs your Hugging Face token as the secret HF_TOKEN
serve.empty: No open model served yet. Connect Modal under Workers first.
serve.emptyReady: No open model served yet. Start one with the form above.
serve.useAs: Use it in an agent as
